title: Line sketch: Metropolis at Sunset
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A futuristic cityscape with skyscrapers, cranes, and long bridges spans a reflective body of water beneath a massive glowing sun. The composition centers the orb amid streaked clouds, with silhouetted buildings and shimmering light paths creating depth. Bold painterly strokes and a saturated warm-cool palette evoke an atmospheric, graphic quality (derived from painting #96).
